intent_contract.text: 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘

Create an independent reference-guided photographic stress test in which the selected random complex concept makes the continuous cloth, waist wrap, front pleats, and shoulder pallu of a Nivi-draped sari visibly judgeable.

Create a full-length photorealistic monsoon textile editorial: a sandstone-stepwell scene built around a Nivi-draped sari at the first edge of rain. The subject is the same adult woman shown in the supplied portrait reference. Her facial structure, eye aperture and spacing, nose, lips, jawline, adult age, and long dark hair remain faithfully matched to that reference. She wears one continuous sari wrapped at the waist, with multiple front pleats tucked above the petticoat and the pallu crossing the torso to fall from the left shoulder over a fitted blouse. She lifts a brass rain gauge from a stone step while the damp pallu draws outward in the new wind, exposing the route of the cloth without breaking its continuity. Show the waist wrap, aligned front pleats, blouse boundary, diagonal torso crossing, shoulder turn, and free pallu end together. Use full-body stair geometry, wet sandstone reflections, fine rain, natural skin texture, and warm storm-filtered light.
